title: The Cheek Test for a Sleepy Kite
youtube_title: The Cheek Test for a Sleepy Kite | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience is doing the right small things until the moment arrives.
summary: Orla's kite will not rise in the still morning until she waits, feels the wind on her cheek, and lets go only when the ribbon of air is real.
